title: OP Sandstone
description: This pack makes Sandstone stairs and walls drop OP shulker boxes, which are containing mid-high tier loot.
body:
Overview
This resource pack provides a clean and enhanced look for your Minecraft survival experience. It focuses on improving the visual clarity of the inventory and storage containers.

What's inside?
As seen in the screenshots, the pack includes:
* **Custom Shulker Box & Bundle GUI:** A sleek, semi-transparent or gray-themed interface for Shulker Boxes and Bundles that makes organizing your loot much easier.
* **Item Icons:** High-quality textures for survival essentials such as:
    * **Armor & Tools:** Diamond/Netherite gear, swords, and pickaxes.
    * **Consumables:** Golden apples (Enchanted and regular), various potions, and splash potions.
    * **Blocks:** Shulker boxes, diamond blocks, emerald blocks, and obsidian.
    * **End Game Items:** Ender pearls, crossbows, and firework rockets.
* **Clarity:** Every item is designed to be easily recognizable at a glance, perfect for PvP or fast-paced survival.

This is the initial version, and it has been fully tested for bugs to ensure a smooth experience! 
Try it now and kill the ender dragon, have fun!
